args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since deploying v2.3.1 (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing (`healthy: false`, error rate 0.18).
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the latest production release and was unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).
2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

**Verification:**
- Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, `healthy: true`, with error rate back down to 0.002.
